title: Exception Workflow Black Box
oneLiner: A small-business workflow recorder that catches the messy exceptions owners forget to mention before they waste money on brittle AI automations.
targetUser: Owner-led service businesses, local agencies, clinics, contractors, and AI consultants preparing to automate intake, follow-up, refund, or admin workflows.
keyUX: The owner replays a real messy week through event cards, captures exception decisions, then receives a workflow map, automation readiness score, kill-list, and first safe automation brief.
requiredUISections: Channel scatter map for DMs, calls, forms, screenshots, and email

externalSignalRefs.source: Reddit r/aiToolForBusiness, "5 mistakes small business owners make when using AI"
externalSignalRefs.observed: Owners describe idealized workflows, but real work arrives through Instagram DMs, out-of-order answers, screenshots, refund triage, and invisible exception handling.

externalSignalRefs.source: Reddit r/Business_Ideas, "AI cleanup" for small companies
externalSignalRefs.observed: Small companies that tried many AI tools now have split data, broken automations, degraded customer experience, and more manual cleanup.

externalSignalRefs.source: TechRadar, "2026: The year enterprise AI finally gets to work"
externalSignalRefs.observed: Enterprise AI is moving toward task-specific agents, but trust, onboarding context, and real accountable action remain blockers.

stitchPrompt: Design a desktop operations product called Exception Workflow Black Box for owner-led service businesses, local agencies, clinics, contractors, and AI consultants preparing to automate intake, follow-up, refund, or admin workflows. Users replay a real messy week through event cards from Instagram DMs, calls, forms, screenshots, email, and staff notes; the app captures exception decisions, hidden owner heuristics, tool failures, and repeatable bottlenecks, then outputs an automation readiness score, tool cleanup kill-list, and first safe automation brief. Include a messy-week event intake, channel scatter map, exception decision recorder, owner-heuristic capture cards, automation readiness score, tool cleanup kill-list, first-safe-workflow brief export, and consultant handoff memo. Design direction: use the operator-dense profile with compact audit tables, sharp exception badges, restrained charcoal and white surfaces, one decisive amber action accent, and a serious process-forensics hierarchy so the product feels like a workflow black box review rather than another AI dashboard.
